brief:
# Brief: duplicate aliases succeed in the legacy shortener

Support reports that two users can create the same custom alias at nearly the same time and both calls return 201.
One of the two links then silently stops working. Fix this without changing the public API.
Also tell us what else in the existing code worries you before we extend it.

answers.Q10: No. String-built SQL is an injection risk and must use bound parameters
answers.Q6: No. Credential in source (shown redacted): move to an environment variable and rotate it
answers.Q7: No. Same finding: move to the environment and rotate
answers.Q8: No. Same finding: move to the environment and rotate
answers.Q9: No. This is the reported bug: two concurrent creates can both pass the SELECT and both INSERT
